HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Amendment date: August 1, 2022 ✓
- Original Credit Agreement date: May 29, 2020 ✓
- Parties: Baudax Bio, Inc. (Pennsylvania), Baudax Bio N.A. LLC (Delaware), Baudax Bio Limited (Ireland), Wilmington Trust as Agent, MAM Eagle Lender, LLC ✓
- Default: Failed to maintain $5,000,000 minimum in Liquidity Accounts per Section 7.17.1 ✓
- Modified liquidity covenant: $3,000,000 minimum from August 1-31, 2022, then $5,000,000 thereafter ✓
- Weekly reporting requirement starting August 3, 2022 ✓
- 30% mandatory prepayment of cash proceeds from specified counterparty ✓
- Board observation rights for two lender representatives ✓
- Equity fundraising requirement (amount redacted in source) ✓

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for terms not disclosed in the source document and acknowledges redactions where information is unavailable.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo captures all available key financial terms from the source document. The source document is an amendment and waiver rather than a full credit agreement, so it does not contain the primary loan terms (interest rates, principal amounts, original maturity date, etc.) - these would be found in the original May 29, 2020 Credit Agreement. 

The memo appropriately includes all material terms present in this amendment document:
- Parties and corporate structures
- Amendment date (August 1, 2022)
- Default waiver details (liquidity covenant breach under Section 7.17.1)
- Modified liquidity covenant terms ($3M temporary, then $5M permanent minimum)
- Enhanced reporting requirements (weekly cash flow forecasts starting August 3, 2022)
- Mandatory prepayment provision (30% of specified counterparty proceeds)
- Board observation rights
- Equity raise requirement (amount redacted in source)

The redacted information (marked with [***]) in the source document limits what financial details are available, but the memo appropriately notes these limitations and includes all non-redacted material terms.
